# v0.18.0: what a provider's screen says about a withdrawal, per server state.
#
# Both halves read this file. The server (server/brain/ledger.py WITHDRAWAL_TEXT) is the
# only source of the state; the phone (core/LedgerView.kt) shows exactly the text on the
# same line and nothing else. The product rule: the screen says "withdrawal requested",
# "being sent" or "paid" ACCURATELY - never a state the ledger cannot vouch for. A ledger
# cannot send money, so "Envoi en cours" means a treasurer marked it sent by hand, and
# "Payé" means the operator's own message (or the treasurer's typed reference) confirmed it.
#
# One STATE|text per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

REQUESTED|Retrait demandé
APPROVED|Retrait demandé
SENT|Envoi en cours
PAID|Payé
DENIED|Refusé
CANCELLED|Annulé
NEEDS_ATTENTION|En vérification
